title: Docker
explain: A multi-stage Dockerfile compiles your program in a full Go image, then copies only the binary into a tiny final image. Setting `CGO_ENABLED=0` produces a static binary that runs without system libraries. The result is a small image with very little inside it to attack.
code:
FROM golang:1.22 AS build
WORKDIR /src
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /app .

FROM gcr.io/distroless/static
COPY --from=build /app /app
ENTRYPOINT ["/app"]
exercise: Build an image of your server with `docker build -t myapp .` and run it with `docker run -p 8080:8080 myapp`.
tip: Add a `.dockerignore` so `.git` and local build files don't get copied into the build. It speeds builds up and avoids leaking files.
